/commit reviewer feature {"number":11,"title":"rename experts → mental-model across commands, skills, and docs","body":"## Summary

- Renames `commands/experts/` → `commands/mental-model/` with domain-prefixed subdirs (`experience-frontend`, `experience-integrations`, `experience-server`, `adw`)
- Renames `skills/meta-experts/` → `skills/meta-mental-model/`
- Renames `build-qa-experts.md` → `build-mental-models.md`
- Adds `create-mental-model.md` and `build-with-mental-models.md` commands
- Updates `done.md`, `prime.md`, `scaffold.md` to reference new `mental-model` paths
- Updates `docs/commands-reference.md` and `docs/experts-guide.md`
- Adds `specs/mental-model-naming-and-commands.md` design spec

## Why

"Experts" was an implementation term. "Mental models" better describes what these YAML + command sets represent — the agent's domain knowledge and reasoning patterns for a specific part of the codebase.

## Test plan

- [ ] `/mental-model:adw:question` resolves correctly
- [ ] `/mental-model:experience-server:self-improve` resolves correctly
- [ ] `/done` suggests correct mental-model paths
- [ ] `/prime` and `/scaffold` load without broken references"}
